title: City Appoints Key Court Official
summary:
*   City leaders held an executive session focused on personnel.
*   They officially appointed Billy F. Nalls as the new Deputy Clerk of the Corporation Court.
*   Mr. Nalls' starting salary was set at $244 per month, slated to increase to $248 after six months.
*   The appointment received unanimous approval.

The appointment of a Deputy Clerk of the Corporation Court was before the Council. After
discussion, Councilman Long moved that MR. BILLY F. NALLS be appointed Deputy Clerk of the
Corporation Court, in Step II, $244.00, to be raised to $248 in six months. The motion,
seconded by Councilman White, carried by the following vote: Ayes: Councilmen Long,
Pearson, Thompson, White, Mayor McAden Noes: None
The meeting adjourned.
